predecessors.name: Shunten and Eiso dynasties (Okinawa)
predecessors.text: the south of Okinawa Island: the Lord of Ōzato 'established himself in Ōzato gusuku near the town of Itoman'

successors.name: Ryukyu Kingdom
successors.text: conquered by Shō Hashi, lord of Chūzan, in 1429, 'marking the end of the independent kingdom of Nanzan'

ledger.x: 1314: the Lord of Ōzato declares Nanzan in the south of Okinawa.
1429: Shō Hashi of Chūzan seizes Nanzan and unites Okinawa.

wars.name: Chūzan's conquest of Nanzan
wars.outcome: Chūzan victory: Shō Hashi took Nanzan after Taromai's death in the late 1420s and united Okinawa.

certainty.note: A castle-lord realm with no recorded frontier; the border with Chūzan is approximate.
